idea: Column-strip construction: split the unit square into vertical strips of widths w_i, and stack c_i equal squares of side min(w_i, 1/c_i) in each strip. Each strip may also be recursively split horizontally into sub-strips. Optimise the integers c_i by DP, setting the widths to w_i = 1/c_i where possible and giving any leftover width to a final strip, to cover counts the square-grid families miss.
